attempt:  010 (previous)
release:  46fd4452ebc7b861abb5cb9b1963178088b978a7
origin:   https://app.pintarselalu.com
purpose:  ACTIVATION STAGE 1 — provision SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY into Vercel
          production and prove it works in the running application.

why:      the key is a RUNTIME value. Writing it to Vercel changes nothing
          until a deployment is built carrying it, so this stage is a real
          redeploy of the frozen release, not a configuration edit.

          Presence is asserted by name from the Vercel API, and then function
          is proven separately: the public certificate-verification endpoint
          constructs a service-role client on every request and throws without
          the key, so a missing key is a 500. An unknown token must answer 404
          with the endpoint's closed body. Both must hold.

          This closes Second Eye carry-forward item 2, which covers five API
          routes: /api/verifikasi/[token], /api/certificates/issue,
          /api/evaluation/assume, /api/assets/upload-url, /api/assets/read-url.

not in scope: the bootstrap, the 3c transition, onboarding, Gladys.
              Supabase Auth remains gated and is not touched by this workflow.
